headline: stage A reproduces the published substrate exactly; the recorded [unverified] version-drift risk MATERIALIZED as two breaks caught by the 24 s smoke gate; the recorded cost figure is NOT reproducible here and thread pinning is worth 2.34x

package.note: install name != import name; installing the import name 404s

stage_a.meaning: the re-fetched GSE144621 substrate reproduces the published one exactly

version_breaks.what: from promoter_calculator import Promoter_Calculator raises ImportError
version_breaks.cause: 1.2.4 __init__.py re-exports only the lowercase promoter_calculator FUNCTION from wrapper; the CLASS moved to the promoter_calculator.promoter_calculator submodule
version_breaks.observed: 40 errored tiles, zero rows, in 24 s
version_breaks.fix: _load_calculator tries the RECORDED top-level path first, then the submodule

version_breaks.what: d.get(field, nan) raises AttributeError on every site
version_breaks.cause: each per-TSS value is a PromoCalcResults object defining __getitem__ / __setitem__ / keys() but NOT get
version_breaks.severity: decompose_one catches broadly, so every site turned its whole tile into a FAILED tile rather than a visibly wrong one
version_breaks.fix: _site_field subscripts (valid on both shapes) and catches

version_breaks.what: hex35_position is a real list [25, 31], not the string the docstring describes
version_breaks.impact: NONE - _int_start stringifies first; 0 of 2920 rows failed to parse
version_breaks.fix: pinned by test so a tidy-up cannot break the live shape

class_is_unchanged.evidence: 1.2.4 own wrapper.py constructs Promoter_Calculator(threads=, verbosity=) and reads output()[Forward_Predictions_per_TSS] exactly as this worker does
class_is_unchanged.consequence: these are an import-PATH fix and a container-SHAPE fix, NOT a model swap, which is what lets stage C frozen reconcile anchors stay the right acceptance test

smoke_gate.value: caught both version breaks in 24 s instead of after ~11 h

cost.constructor_note: free, so the cost is inside Promoter_Calculator.run() and is NOT amortizable by reusing the object
cost.ab_design: true A/B on the real workload - same tiles, same 7 workers, same launcher, only the environment differing
cost.reusable_rule: when a worker pool underperforms its single-process timing, suspect the single-process timing was ALREADY parallel; the per-WORKER rate, not the aggregate, is the diagnostic

recorded_cost_figure.gap: 785 tiles/min needs ~0.5 core-seconds/tile against the 8.7 measured, a ~17x gap no thread setting explains
recorded_cost_figure.resolution: UNRESOLVED - deliberately not reconciled by argument
recorded_cost_figure.consequence: the technical plan written this morning budgeted ~1 h and called it the one real cost, on a figure off by more than an order of magnitude

isolation_rationale_correction.my_earlier_claim: the sklearn-1.9.1 isolation premise is REFUTED
isolation_rationale_correction.measured: in a FRESH env promotercalculator 1.2.4 DOES pull scikit-learn 1.9.1; the project-env dry-run stayed at 1.8.0 only because the existing pin already satisfied the resolver
isolation_rationale_correction.standing: the separate environment is correct for BOTH reasons - the fresh-resolve conflict is real AND uv.lock is a frozen reproducibility unit

resume.mechanism: completed_tiles read the killed run truncated gzip, caught the EOF and dropped the last tile, because a tile killed mid-write holds only some of its ~73 rows and has-at-least-one-row would read as complete

supervision.why: four long runs died unattended on this host in one week; the previous full run of this exact stage was killed by teardown at 88.4%. Resume-safety is worth nothing if nothing re-launches
states: died with retries left -> relaunch with --resume
died with retries exhausted -> stop and leave the evidence
safety_properties: retry CAP, so an instantly-failing job cannot become a hot loop that buries the real error
coverage check, so a COMPLETED run cannot be restarted over its own finished output
undetermined coverage RESUMES rather than declaring completion
supervision.idle_only_coverage: decompressing a growing gzip during a live run is the recorded trap that turned a ~1 h job into a 5.0 h projection
launch_defects_found: an INDENTED here-string terminator is a PowerShell parse error - the first watchdog silently never started and wrote no log
an unquoted -File path split on the space in Laptop Portable, so PowerShell never received a valid script path
uv venv python.exe is a trampoline, so multiprocessing spawn launches the BASE interpreter - a liveness check grepping the venv path does not match the workers

decision_needed.item: if stage C frozen reconcile gate FAILS
decision_needed.rule: report INDETERMINATE_RECONCILE_FAILED. Do NOT tune it away. Editing PREREGISTERED is a USER-AUTHORITY call

honest_limits: the run was IN FLIGHT when this was written; no completion, no 44106/44106 coverage and no stage-C verdict is claimed
the reconcile gate has NOT run - whether the regenerated table reproduces the published substrate is the open empirical question
rate is derived from output growth against a bytes-per-tile constant (3654) measured on the 40-tile smoke; compression ratio can drift with content, so the ETA is approximate
the ~11 h projection rests on ONE 5-minute window on an otherwise idle machine
8 workers would be expected to gain ~1.3 h more; NOT tried, a second restart was not worth the progress and attention
the 2026-10-12 shard set (88.4% complete) is NOT recoverable - it was on the detached volume
